extraction.Name: Grace Bonser Soedt
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded September 24, 1923 by Mrs. Grace B. Soedt
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739624 issued; west half of the northwest quarter and the west half of the southwest quarter of section 17, township 38, range 29; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 2, 1920; no other instrument of record in the Register of Deeds' office concerning the land; apparently no judgments or liens of record; 1927 and prior taxes have been paid; at the time records were inspected on February 13, 1929, the only adverse item found was taxes amounting to $36.88 for the year 1928
